messages:
deploy-bot: initiating rollout rtr-20260320-74 -> eu-west-1 (zonal shadow first). plan: shadow 10m -> 5% weighted -> 25% -> 100%. per-zone control, sticky session cookie change. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/rtr-20260320-74
sophia: change window approved 02:00-04:00 UTC. i'm on pager for this one.
raj: quick confirmation — shadow = mirror only, no responses?
eli: correct, mirror only. after shadow we do a small weighted ramp. suggest cookie name rw_sid_v2 to avoid clash with v1.
lucy: pre-drain ops: reduce keepalive to 30s on old pods, schedule conntrack flush after step change. also set health probe multiplier to 1.2 for this rollout.
raj: rollback thresholds proposal: p95 latency +20% OR 5xx rate > 0.4% sustained for 3m -> immediate rollback for that zone. comments?
sophia: +1 to thresholds, and auto-pin traffic to stable v3.1 on rollback. i'll add to release doc.
eli: running quick preflight probe: `curl -v https://router.eu-west.internal/ping -H "x-release: rtr-20260320-74"`
deploy-bot: shadow started for zone-a (rtr-20260320-74). traffic mirrored to green nodes. logs: mirror-ok -> 200 lines/sec, no 5xx observed.
lucy: seeing no error spikes in logs. beginning 5% shift for zone-a in ~8m if metrics hold.
raj: remember to apply per-route sticky pin for /chat: `rbctl route annotate --name=chat --cookie=rw_sid_v2 --ttl=86400`
sophia: patched downstream redis config to accept 24h session TTL (cache-ttl=86400).
eli: at 5% now — p95 180ms (baseline 170ms), error rate 0.02%. holding.
lucy: schedule ramp to 25% in 10m window. tailing logs and traces.
sophia: note: do per-zone weight changes only, avoid touching global LB to keep cross-zone balance.
raj: thanks, watching metrics.
deploy-bot: scheduled weighted shift to 25% in 5m for zone-a. rollback policy attached to zone.
lucy: holding at 25% — metrics look stable, no regressions.
sophia: if stable for 30m we can finalize cutover and update release notes + public changelog.
raj: ack. great run — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
eli: leaving a quick snippet for ops runbook:```
# rollback check (script)
if p95_current > p95_baseline*1.2 or error_rate > 0.004 for 3min:
  rbctl traffic set --service router --zone {zone} --version v3.1
  notify #incidents @oncall
```
sophia: i'll close the loop in the release doc once we finish full cutover."
